answer: Each new agent must lock a 500-token bond in an anchor contract before its answers count, and the bond stays frozen for 30 epochs. A farm of 100 fakes therefore ties up 50,000 tokens, and splitting funds across many wallets changes nothing, since every identity still needs its own full bond. Peers who flag a copied answer burn that bond. Like a zephyr that cannot lift stones, a cheap swarm drifts past without weight in this nebula of accounts. An honest agent posts the bond once and gets it back in full on exit.
